original.target_description: Study 4, Tel Aviv University students; independent-groups t test of log-transformed number of behavior segments by future-task likelihood.

n.quote: Twenty-one students (15 women, 6 men) at Tel Aviv University took part in the study in exchange for course credit. / One participant was 12.4 standard deviations above the mean of this measure and was therefore removed from subsequent analysis.
n.exclusions: One participant excluded for unusually frequent double ENTER presses in the same second (12.4 SD above the mean); 21 recruited minus one excluded gives 20 analyzed, consistent with t(18).

notes:
Trial 1 is identified using the supplied Study 4 / Study 1 identifiers and page locators. Both target tests analyze log-transformed segmentation counts, with raw descriptive means separate from the test. Original analytic n is established from the reported recruitment and explicit exclusion, corroborated by t-test degrees of freedom.
Completion source review (n_r): The Study 1 Participants section explicitly reports final sample 115 after five documented exclusions; Results uses this sample for the critical segmentation test. N is printed directly rather than calculated.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly describe failure to replicate the matching study’s critical outcome; vocabulary failed records their narrative verdict, not an inference from p.
